reading.body:
Google operates a long-running data center campus in Berkeley County (Moncks Corner), South Carolina, but publishes no individual building capacity, square footage, or address for this site. The operator discloses only aggregate state-level investment figures on its own data center location pages. Recent announcements indicate a $500 million expansion specific to this Moncks Corner location and a combined $3.3 billion investment across two South Carolina campuses announced in September 2024, but the specific megawatt capacity of this campus is not disclosed.

South Carolina has 14 mapped data center facilities, only four of which publish power capacity figures. Among those four facilities with published specs in the state, this Google campus ranks fifth, behind four other disclosed sites. The state's four published facilities total 6.6 MW, a figure that reflects only the small fraction of mapped capacity the operators have chosen to disclose and does not represent the actual scale of data center operations in South Carolina.

Without published capacity figures for this site, its significance to AI scaling cannot be read from disclosed power. The scale of announced investment and the campus's status as one of Google's original US facilities suggest material relevance to the operator's infrastructure plans, but converting that investment to compute or power assumptions would require facts the operator has not published.
